conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND resource.type="cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.job_name="__JOB_NAME__" AND metric.labels.result="failed"

documentation.content: The monthly exit-kit check __JOB_NAME__ failed: converting the newest backup into standard files (SDF/CSV) did not work, or its self-check found differences. The backup itself is not affected, but the exit kit (README: "Restoring, or moving away from CDD") may not work on the current data. See `make logs JOB=exit-kit` (FAIL lines or a traceback), reproduce with `make exit-kit`, fix exit_kit.py, then `make deploy-exit-kit`.
